notes: LANDED kb/Work PB1127, PB3233. A constant-name literal-1/literal-3 (13.10.3 SR2) is substituted before the size check sees it: equal-size constants run (R2 in the positive golden), unequal sizes draw the SR6 COBOL0846 instead of the wrong-rule COBOL1639. PB3233: a figurative literal-1, a bare symbolic character included, is SR3's 'implicit one character data item' and is measured as one character by the ONE size rule StatementValidation.CheckInspectLiteralSizes (shared with SR9), so ALL SPACE BY "QR" draws COBOL0846 at every edition (it compiled clean and left identifier-1 unchanged); only a figurative literal-3 is exempt. retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Compiler/Binding/Validation/StatementValidation.cs#CheckInspectReplacingSize (kb/Work PB3233 merged the SR6 and SR9 size checks into the one rule StatementValidation.CheckInspectLiteralSizes)
